title: Auto Detail Flow - Photos to Booked Job
description: A managed auto-detailing workflow from photo intake to follow-up.
headline: Quote from a complete vehicle brief, not a 19-message photo thread.
subheadline: Collect the right photos once, approve a package, reserve the job after a deposit receipt, and make follow-up automatic to the team.
buyer_signal: The owner prices jobs from scattered texts and photos, then manually reconciles deposits, travel time, and the calendar.
outcome: Every booked vehicle has approved scope, photos, and prep notes.
before: Photos arrive without vehicle details, price changes are buried in chat, and travel or weather conflicts surface late.
after: A complete vehicle brief becomes an approved package, external deposit receipt, buffered appointment, and follow-up task.

steps.name: Photo intake
steps.detail: Collect vehicle, condition, goals, location, and required views.

steps.name: Pricing
steps.detail: Draft package and condition add-ons for approval.

steps.name: Deposit
steps.detail: Stage cancellation terms and payment handoff.

steps.name: Schedule
steps.detail: Reserve service, travel, and weather buffer.

steps.name: Follow-up
steps.detail: Queue care, review, and seasonal rebook tasks.

benefits.title: Quote on evidence
benefits.detail: The required photo checklist reduces avoidable scope surprises.

benefits.title: Protect the route
benefits.detail: A confirmed job includes location, travel buffer, and prep notes.

benefits.title: Earn the next visit
benefits.detail: Each completed detail creates a care and rebooking task.

faq.question: Does AI decide the final price?
faq.answer: No. Rules can prepare a draft, but the detailer approves condition, scope, and price.

faq.question: Where are customer photos stored?
faq.answer: This starter configures no upload store. The production design must use an approved private store and retention policy.

faq.question: Does it charge a deposit?
faq.answer: No. Live payments are disabled until the operator and customer approve the final configuration.

faq.question: Can it handle mobile travel zones?
faq.answer: Yes. A build can map approved ZIP or radius rules to travel buffers and owner review.
